/digital-risk/ai-liability.title: AI Liability Insurance | Auxilium Specialty
/digital-risk/ai-liability.description: The Autonomous Operations Policy covers what your AI agents do: the money they move, the commitments they make and the records they change. Written in the E&S market through your broker.

/coverages.title: Coverages | Auxilium Specialty
/coverages.description: Insuring the industrial revolution: the risks of autonomy across the digital and physical worlds. AI liability for the businesses that run AI and the vendors that build it, three robotics lines, and the risk-mitigation software that comes with the policy.

/about.title: About Auxilium Specialty | Insuring Industrial Revolutions
/about.description: A managing general agent insuring the industrial revolutions of the AI era, with reinsurance rigor and quantitative underwriting for the risks incumbents exclude or misprice.

/partners.title: Partners: Brokers and Carriers | Auxilium Specialty
/partners.description: Place frontier-technology risk with Auxilium, or build capacity as a carrier or reinsurer. AI Liability and the robotics lines are placed through licensed brokers.

/insights.title: Insights | Auxilium Specialty
/insights.description: Analysis on AI liability, agent governance, and the emerging risks of frontier technology from the Auxilium Specialty underwriting team.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Auxilium Specialty
/privacy.description: How Auxilium Specialty collects, uses, and protects information across its insurance and software offerings.

/terms.title: Terms of Service | Auxilium Specialty
/terms.description: The terms governing use of the Auxilium Specialty website, software, and services.

/software/auxcontrol.title: AuxControl: active risk mitigation for insureds | Auxilium Specialty
/software/auxcontrol.description: The risk-mitigation suite included with an Auxilium policy: adversarial testing of deployed agents, accreditation, and continuous governance.

/digital-risk/vendor-certification.title: Agent Library & Vendor Certification | Auxilium Specialty
/digital-risk/vendor-certification.description: Free certification for AI agent products and the vendors that build agents. Certify once, and every customer running your agents gets faster quotes and better pricing.

/robotics/robot-maker-liability.title: Robot Maker Liability | Auxilium Specialty
/robotics/robot-maker-liability.description: Robotics Vendor Cover: liability for the robots you make, lease, integrate or run, with no AI exclusion. Written in the E&S market through your broker.

/robotics/automaton-fleet-protection.title: Automaton & Fleet Protection | Auxilium Specialty
/robotics/automaton-fleet-protection.description: Robot Protection: cover for every robot you run, including the robot, the downtime and the liability your GL now excludes. Through your broker, or included in your robot vendor's sale or lease.

/robotics/home-humanoid-protection.title: Home Humanoid Protection | Auxilium Specialty
/robotics/home-humanoid-protection.description: Cover for home humanoids, included in the lease or subscription under the maker's master policy. Coming 2029.
